# GeoEditor

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Draw and edit GeoJSON geometry with a visual editor.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/geo-editor",
  "type": "GeoEditorOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/geo-editor').par.geojson` (an input) and `op('/geo-editor').out.featureCollection` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.geojson`, `out.featureCollection`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `geojson` | `CodeField` | `"{\n  \"type\": \"FeatureCollection\",\n  \"features\": []\n}"` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `featureCollection` | `GeoJsonField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->

## Remarks

- **Edit on map** (on the node and in Properties) opens the Draw tool on the main map with these shapes loaded. Under **Edit points**, Move drags points, Add puts a point where you click an edge, and Remove deletes the point you click. **Save to** writes the shapes back to `geojson` as one undo step.
- Edit on map is turned off while `geojson` comes from a connection, an expression or keyframes, since any of them would overwrite the saved shapes.
